Q1: Open PR #9246 already seems to fix this closed-reader test failure on ubuntu-26.04. How should this issue proceed?
Choices:
A) Don't build a separate fix. Hand off to PR #9246: once it merges, this issue's PR #8967 failure clears on rebase or re-run. This issue becomes a tracking issue only (RECOMMENDED)
B) Build an independent fix on the default branch now, in `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` `gh_retry`'s replay step, so a closed reader gives a non-zero status no matter which `cat` the runner has. The test contract stays as it is. Accept that this may conflict with or duplicate #9246
C) Build the fix inside PR #8967's branch (`ai/issue-8963`). **Note:** this goes against the issue's own guidance that a failure also seen on main must be fixed on the base branch, not in PR #8967
